title: Stockholmsbörsen: XACT SBX – en ny börshandlad fond noteras, 2 juni 2003
locator: Press release body; publication shown 2003-06-02 10:17 CET by archive
supported: XACT SBX listed that day; SBX launched 12 April 2001; base 30 December 1995 = 100; semiannual revisions; 80–100 liquid shares.
not_supported: Does not establish first ever SBX passive demand, exact seed capital, an unanticipated shock, or historical ADs.

title: MSCI/NOREX: new GICS classification and benchmark indices, 27 November 2000
supported: Free-float investability was an original design feature. Stockholm GICS adoption scheduled 5 January 2001. Benchmark launch was then planned for February 2001.
not_supported: The announced February plan is not evidence of actual February SBX launch. Later exchange source S01 states actual 12 April 2001.
short_quote: new benchmark indices, which take into account free float

title: Sjunde AP-fonden: Årsredovisning 2002, del 2
locator: Printed pp.4/10: allocation by style; pp.5/11: benchmark switch; pp.8/14: audit dated 13 February 2003. PDF zero-based pages 5/11, 6/12, 9/15.
supported: Pre-ETF Swedish index-management sleeves and explicit SBX transition in both funds.
not_supported: Style allocation is not total-fund weight, exact replication, review orders or dated tracker AUM.
short_quote: SBX Stockholmsbörsens benchmarkindex (från och med den 1 augusti 2002)

title: Andra AP-fonden: Årsredovisning 2002
locator: Printed pp.20–21 (PDF zero-based 21–22), Swedish equities discussion and Swedish SIXRX/SBX mandate table; p.44 (PDF45) style split.
supported: Benchmark switch in autumn 2002: 70% Swedish equity reference SBX, remainder OSX/CSX. Internal portfolio 1 is labelled passive under combined SIXRX/SBX mandates; SEB and Carlson are active.
not_supported: Combined annual SIXRX/SBX label does not date every mandate switch or quantify pure SBX replication capital. Active benchmarked mandates must not be counted as strict passive.

title: OMX Exchanges: Gemensam global branschklassificering för alla NOREX-börser, 19 January 2005
supported: Stockholm, Oslo and Copenhagen had used GICS since 2001; 2005 expansion concerns Helsinki, Iceland and Baltic exchanges.
not_supported: Not a new Stockholm classification regime starting in 2005, and not a documented SBX selection-rule break.

title: OMX Exchanges: OMX harmoniserar indexnamn, 22 August 2005
locator: Opening paragraph and benchmark name paragraph
supported: Stockholm benchmark renamed OMXSB effective 3 October 2005. Narrative also mentions ongoing rule and calculation-system harmonisation.
not_supported: Does not date a specific change in SBX constituent selection, buffers, turnover thresholds, free-float bands or cap treatment. Do not code rename as a methodology shock.

title: OMHEX: sale of XACT Fonder to Svenska Handelsbanken, 16 June 2004
supported: Announced ownership transfer of XACT Fonder, which managed XACT OMX and XACT SBX, effective 30 June 2004.
not_supported: Not an index methodology change; no documented exogenous demand increase or date-specific index purchase quantity.

title: OMX annual report 2004
locator: PDF zero-based p.54, Integration work related to merger of OM and HEX. Text font encoding corrupts numerical page label.
supported: September 2004 integration included harmonisation of trading rules and Stockholm/Helsinki opening hours.
not_supported: This passage does not specify precise before/after clock times or support assuming a constant intraday market model over the sample.

title: OMX Stockholm: Avista, ny sammansättning av OMX Stockholm Benchmark index (175/07), 12 June 2007
supported: New composition effective 2 July 2007, with dated announcement. This is a confirmed historical January/July-era review.
not_supported: Does not verify any of the eight earlier workbook candidate dates or their issuer lists.

title: Nasdaq OMX: New OMX Stockholm Benchmark portfolio selected, 11 May 2009
supported: Composition effective 1 June 2009, showing a later June effective date rather than the older July example.
not_supported: One notice alone is not a complete rule change log. The local verified review calendar documents January 2009 followed by June 2009.
